seo_title: How it works: decide where to go on holiday, fairly | somewhere🎉
seo_description: See how somewhere🎉 works: the family puts holiday ideas on standby, spreads points in secret, lets a fair draw pick the winner, then plans the trip together. Free to use.

hero.heading: From "where shall we go?" to packed, in five steps.
hero.lead: Everyone in the family gets a fair say, nobody has to win the argument, and the trip you end up on is one you all picked. Here's how it goes.

ideas.title: Put your ideas on standby
ideas.text:
Anyone in the family can add a place they'd love to go, from a city break to a week on the beach. Each idea becomes a standby ticket with its type of trip, rough budget and travel time, so you can compare like for like.

Ideas stop getting lost in the group chat. They wait on standby, in one place, until you're ready to choose.

points.title: Everyone spreads their points in secret
points.text:
When it's time to decide, each of you gets the same number of points to share out between the ideas. Put them all on one place you love, or spread them around.

Everyone also gets one veto for somewhere they really can't face. Nobody sees anyone else's points until the draw, so the quietest voice counts as much as the loudest.

draw.title: The draw picks where you go
draw.text:
Every point is a ticket in the draw, so the more points an idea has, the better its chances. But it's never a sure thing.

The departures board flips through the ideas one by one until a single destination is left with a seat. The decision's made, and nobody had to win the argument.

departure.title: Your winner gets a boarding pass
departure.text:
The winning idea becomes your next departure: a boarding pass with where you're going, who's coming and how many nights away.

It counts down the days until you go, right at the top of the app, so the whole family has something to look forward to.

plan.title: Plan the trip together
plan.text:
Your winner gets its own trip plan that everyone can add to: a day-by-day itinerary, a budget that keeps track of what's booked and who paid, and a packing list for each person.

When you're home, the trip moves to Been, and your map and passport fill in. Then it's back to standby for the next one.
